svg.title: InfernoSaber model architecture v2
svg.desc: Production uses seven trained v2 stages and the unchanged retained encoder. Positions, arrows and multiplier create colored notes and chains. Hazards add walls and bombs; arcs connect existing notes. Lighting uses the original v1 fav_15 checkpoint and vocabulary on cleaned gameplay timestamps with legacy16 prefix pairing. Independent v2 lighting remains optional/deferred and is not yet implemented for production. Boxes show input and output tensor shapes and network types. The full autoencoder is used only for reconstruction training and evaluation.
svg.text: 2026-10-19 · seven trained v2 stages + retained encoder + v1 lighting · shapes include batch
App / CLI → one song × requested density
Inputs: audio + requested retained NPS + separate BPM
Production connected; in-game playability review pending
Partial song tails retain their actual duration
Output shares [B,S] · sum over valid bins = 1
No grid snapping or exact-total constraint
local NPS = share × D × duration / bin width
BPM supplies tempo; requested D supplies density.
Cleaned gameplay timestamps · legacy16 prefix pairing
Raw audio → existing 14,800 Hz / 2 s patch extraction
Cache Z at each downstream model’s own query times
Standalone audio input for every model 4–9
Decode one or both hands per timing count
Keep times, hand occupancy and cells fixed
Directed base notes + neighbors / gaps + history
Adds stacks, staggered copies and burst chains
Fixed configured offsets; copies inherit hand / cut
Base anchors survive; final density may increase
Scheduler owns times; model owns placement
Audio: Z [B,16] at cleaned gameplay times
Sigmoid scores → one type/value class per row
Existing same-hand note IDs [B,2] + geometry / gap
Connects existing notes; endpoints / cuts stay fixed
Seconds → beat times · retain v3 + legacy v2 export
Training / reconstruction only · full autoencoder · retained · 159,873 parameters
Directed retained notes; at most one per hand
Z is shared by all downstream models; histories are stage-specific and strictly preceding.
Solid arrows: data flow · dashed arrows: history feedback · v2 denotes the pipeline, not the file format
